بعد Isolating the Pump Mechanically and 
Electrically

Check the impeller and casing from mechanical wear and measure the 
 clearances by dismantle the Pump.
تحقق من المحمل في المضخة.
Prevent the leakage from gasket by renewed it.
Check the coupling's gear and change grease of coupling.
Retighten all bolts connected pump and motor with foundation.

sections.text: Operation of the Pump

Operate the pump by coordination 
 with the shift engineer.

Ensure that the pump is OK and check the 
 direction of rotation, record the 
 readings of pressure, temp., vibration, according to the technical 
 specification table at introduction, and compare with the previous reading.
